from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper and its citation relationships to OTHER provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list/bibliography")
    cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that cite this paper within their text")
    reference_source: str | None = Field(description="Where the reference information was found (e.g., 'bibliography', 'reference section')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
